```{r}
library(tidyverse)

source("source/sim_mean_sd.R")
source("source/sim_slr.R")
source("source/birthday_repeated.R")

set.seed(127)
```

## mean and SD

### let's do this but keep track of results

```{r}
output = vector("list", length = 1000)

for (i in 1:1000){
   output[[i]] = sim_mean_sd(30)
}
```

### inspect results

```{r}
output |> 
  bind_rows() |> 
  summarize(
    emp_m = mean(mean),
    emp_se = sd(mean)
  )
```

```{r}
output |> 
  bind_rows() |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = mean)) +
  geom_density()
```

### let's do this using tibbles and map instead

```{r}
sim_results_df =
  tibble(
    samp_size = rep(30, 1000)
  ) |> 
  mutate(
    est_df = map(samp_size, sim_mean_sd)
  ) |> 
  unnest(est_df)
```

### look at results

```{r}
sim_results_df |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = mean)) +
  geom_density()
```

## change `n`

```{r}
sim_results_df =
  expand_grid(
    samp_size = c(30, 60, 120, 240),
    iter = 1:1000
  ) |> 
  mutate(
    est_df = map(samp_size, sim_mean_sd)
  ) |> 
  unnest(est_df)
```

* expand_grid: gives combination of sample size and iteration up to the highest number (ex. 30, 1; 30, 2; 30, 3;...30, 1000)

```{r}
sim_results_df |> 
  mutate(
    samp_size = str_c("n = ", samp_size),
    samp_size = fct_inorder(samp_size)
  ) |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = samp_size, y = mean)) +
  geom_violin()
```

```{r}
sim_results_df |> 
  mutate(
    samp_size = str_c("n = ", samp_size),
    samp_size = fct_inorder(samp_size)
  ) |> 
  group_by(samp_size) |> 
  summarize(
    emp_m = mean(mean),
    emp_se = sd(mean)
  )
```

## SLR

### generate once

```{r}
sim_data =
  tibble(
    x = rnorm(30, mean = 1, sd = 1),
    y = 2 + 3*x + rnorm(30, mean = 0, sd = 1)
  )

sim_data |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = x, y = y)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE)

fit = lm(y ~ x, data = sim_data)
```

### turn this into a function

(did that, it's in `source/sim_slr.R`)

```{r}
sim_slr(30)
```

### do this a lot

```{r}
slr_results_df = 
  tibble(
    samp_size = rep(30, 1000)
  ) |> 
  mutate(
    est_df = map(samp_size, sim_slr)
  ) |> 
  unnest(est_df)
```

### is this right?

```{r}
slr_results_df |> 
  summarize(
    b0_mean = mean(beta0_hat),
    b0_se = sd(beta0_hat)
  )
```

### look at the results

```{r}
slr_results_df |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = beta0_hat, y = beta1_hat)) +
  geom_point()
```

## birthday problem

```{r}
birthdays = sample(1:365, size = 5, replace = TRUE)

repeated_birthdays = length(unique(birthdays)) < 5

repeated_birthdays
```

### turn into function

(i did)...run it a bunch

```{r}
birthday_repeated(147)
```

run it a bunch but good

```{r}
birthday_results_df = 
  expand_grid(
    number_of_people = 5:50,
    iter = 1:1000
  ) |> 
  mutate(
    repeated = map_lgl(number_of_people, birthday_repeated)
  )
```

* map_lgl: turns numbers into TRUE/FALSE (logical vector)

### look at results

```{r}
birthday_results_df |> 
  group_by(number_of_people) |> 
  summarize(prob_of_repeat = mean(repeated)) |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = number_of_people, y = prob_of_repeat)) +
  geom_point() + 
  geom_line()
```
